said: Do you think I have depression?

So yesterday was a strange day, I woke up really late because I could not fall asleep until almost morning, and then I rushed around the house looking for my keys, and I missed the bus, so I walked to work in the rain, and when I got there my manager was already in a meeting, and I just sat at my desk feeling a bit lost, and then at lunch I called my mother and we talked about nothing really, and it was nice, I suppose, so overall I think I am okay.
I barely slept last night, maybe a few hours, and I'm exhausted.
My sister called me this morning and we ended up arguing again.
My daughter visited me yesterday and we cooked together.
